description: Fork of exp018 (sep Q/K, E=64, H=6, 16k steps, final 1.7411) with: (1) n_steps 16000 → 8000, (2) decorrelation_lambda=1e-3 — a pairwise contrastive regularizer that pushes table rows toward orthogonality. After bit_opt.step(), each LUT's [T, D, O] latents get a small additional update: grad_L_i = sum_{j≠i} <L_i_norm, L_j_norm> L_j_norm (gradient of the off-diagonal Gram-matrix squared sum). Tests whether explicit contrastive pressure speeds up convergence — exp018 reached 1.8038 at step 8000 (without reg). If exp033 beats 1.8038 at 8k, the regularizer accelerates the natural convergence to the orthogonality fixed point.
